_comment: Hand-maintained mapping from Google's public Gemini API pricing page to pricing.json
entries. No model list is held here: the page lists the models, under their API ids.
`source` is the page's Markdown (Markdoc), which Google serves beside the rendered
page. Each model section names its ids, then has one table per tab; `speeds` says what
each tab becomes: standard is the model's entry, batch its `_batch` fields, flex and
priority an entry of their own, `<id> (flex)`, `<id> (priority)`. Contributor, a tier
Google offers by invitation only, is not published (null).
`features` names the rows read and which side of a call each prices; `kinds` forces
the kind of token for a row that names it in its label ('Image input price').
`features_ignored` are rows known and not read: grounding is read once, from the
tools section; tuning is not offered. A row in neither list is reported.
`kinds` maps the words a price states its tokens with, '(text / image / video)', to
kinds of token, and `kind_prefixes` each kind to the prefix of its fields: none for
features_ignored: Grounding with Google Web and Image Search
_comment_prose: The only words a price may be followed by, once its kinds of token, its prompt
length and its dates are read: anything else after a dollar figure fails the run.
prose_without_price: Implicit caching only (explicit caching is not supported).
_comment_tools: Grounding is priced once, in the tools section, by model generation. Each product is
read by its pattern in the paid tier cell of its row; a row named here that is gone,
or priced another way, fails the run. The free allowances before the price (1,500
requests a day, 5,000 a month) have no field; the README states them.

tools.display_name: Grounding with Google Search, Gemini 2.5 models
Grounding with Google Search, Gemini 3 and newer models
tools.pattern: Gemini 3 and newer models:.*?then \$(?P<amount>[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?) per 1,000 requests
